conventions.pog_px: screen target in physical pixels of the native panel (origin top-left)
conventions.3d_frame: camera frame, mm: +X image right, +Y image down, +Z away from the camera
conventions.gaze: origin_mm = midpoint between the eyes; pog_mm = target on the screen plane; vector = unit(pog_mm - origin_mm). origin_mm includes the participant's face-scale factor (user_face_scale)
conventions.head_pose: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker pose re-expressed in the calibrated camera; rotation_rad = extrinsic Euler 'zyx' angles [roll, yaw, pitch]; rotvec_rad = same rotation as axis-angle; translation_mm = origin of MediaPipe's canonical face, multiplied by the participant's face-scale factor (user_face_scale)
conventions.discard_info: null for kept samples; otherwise discarding_reason (code) and its name

user_face_scale.description: Per-participant factor applied to head translation and gaze origin, so that the canonical face matches the participant's face size; estimated from the iris diameter (11.7 mm) over all kept samples of the participant
